items.title: New disclosure: Trump owns SpaceX, Disney shares — and is reaping profits from oil & gas stocks
items.summary: President Trump made over 1,000 new stock trades in June, totaling between $78 million and $263 million.  Yahoo Finance Washington Correspondent Ben Werschkul outlines the details in the video above.

items.title: Why Tesla Is Raising Prices on the Cybertruck—Even as Sales Slow Down
items.summary: The dual-motor all-wheel drive version now starts at about $75,000, up from $70,000, according to Tesla’s website.  Tesla, like other auto makers, is facing higher costs for everything from copper to memory chips.  Price increases help offset cost inflation.

items.title: Tesla Raises Prices on Cybertruck Almost No One Will Buy
items.summary: Tesla just hiked Cybertruck prices on a vehicle that has been called the biggest flop in automotive history, and the reasoning behind that decision is nearly impossible to defend.

items.title: Tesla Hikes Prices For Struggling Cybertruck; Stock Faces Key Test
items.summary: Tesla hiked prices for two Cybertruck trims on Tuesday. Tesla stock is trying to get back above a key moving average.

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: Tesla's Biggest Robotics Advantage Isn't AI, RoboStrategy CEO Says
items.summary: When investors think about Tesla Inc‘s (NASDAQ:TSLA) humanoid robotics ambitions, the conversation usually begins with artificial intelligence. Andrew Kang, CEO of RoboStrategy, Inc. (NASDAQ:BOT), argues they’re looking in the wrong place. Tesla’s greatest long-term advantage is something far less glamorous, he says. “It is their manufacturing competency and resources,” Kang told Benzinga in an email. items.title: Forget EV Sales: This Is the Number That Could Decide Tesla’s Future
items.summary: Wall Street obsesses over Tesla delivery numbers, but there is a quieter metric quietly reshaping what Tesla actually is as a company, and it has nothing to do with how many cars roll off the line.
